aiOverview.content: The Artemis II astronauts safely splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, on April 10, 2026. The crew returned to Earth following a 10-day mission around the moon, with recovery teams retrieving them via helicopter to the USS John P. Murtha.Key Landing Details:Location: Pacific Ocean, near San Diego.Mission: Artemis II (first crewed moon mission since 1972).Recovery Vessel: USS John P.
